observed.backend: repeated restart during unauthenticated Elasticsearch readiness loop
observed.celery_worker: not started because backend was not healthy
observed.frontend: not started because backend was not healthy

cause: The exact retained r13x /docker-entrypoint.sh parsed the ES URL only into scheme, host, and port, discarding embedded credentials before its readiness curl. It also omitted the Redis URL password in its Python readiness ping.
recovery_condition: Use the same exact r13x backend base with only the corrected /docker-entrypoint.sh, record the derived identity, retain authenticated Elasticsearch and Redis, then rerun the fresh local stack.
